section_header: AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM — Functional Test and Adjustment
title: Air Mix Damper Linkage

content.description: Air mix damper assembly showing components labeled MAX COOL, MAX HOT, ROD, and CLAMP

items.title: CHECK AIR MIX DAMPER
subitems: (a) Disconnect the rod from the clamp.

(b) Disconnect the No. 4 vacuum hose between the D.V.V and vacuum motor in the tower servo unit to release the vacuum pressure in the vacuum motor. The stem of the power servo extends fully to the maximum cooling position.
(c) Position the damper to maximum cooling and connect the rod to the clamp.
(d) Using a commercial vacuum pump, apply 250 mmHg (9.84 in.Hg, 33.3 kPa) of vacuum to the vacuum motor and verify that the damper moves to the maximum heating position.

items.title: REINSTALL REMOVED PARTS IN REVERSE ORDER

content.description: Photograph showing in-car sensor mounted in console box area
Technical drawing of ambient sensor showing cylindrical sensor with mounting bracket

items.title: IN-CAR SENSOR
items.text:
(Located in console box)
Check sensor resistance.
2 — 5.5 kΩ (0 — 25°C or 32 — 77°F)

items.title: VERIFY AIR IS SUCKED IN NEAR SENSOR
items.text: NOTE: If there is an open circuit in the sensor, the system will operate at maximum heating. Conversely, if there is a short in the system, it will operate at maximum cooling.

items.title: AMBIENT SENSOR
items.text:
(Located on condenser)
Check sensor resistance.
0.4 — 0.6 kΩ (0 — 25°C or 32 — 77°F)

content.text: NOTE: If there is an open circuit in the sensor, the system will operate at maximum heating. Conversely, if there is a short in the system, it will operate at maximum cooling.
